verdict.rationale: The manual says Working Copy 'supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab', which fits the story, but the excerpt cuts off the antecedent of 'these', so it does not explicitly name pull requests. Hosting-provider integration (docs-48, docs-9) makes the PR reading plausible, but the capability is only implied, not clearly stated. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that pull requests are what can be created, a description of the PR creation workflow (choosing branches, title and description), clarity on self-hosted instance support for PRs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create pull requests on hosted Git platforms directly from my device

citations.quote: Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab.
There is special support for GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab and other hosting providers to list your available repositories
